name: Code Graph Builder
tagline: Understand any codebase instantly with a queryable code graph
description: Code Graph Builder scans TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go, and 8 other languages and builds a persistent SQLite graph database with better-sqlite3 (WAL, FTS5). AI agents can call 30 MCP tools to explore dependencies, estimate change impact, detect architectural communities, find dead code, generate documentation, and more.
